title: Local deterministic project continuity for supported agents

work.title: Integrate Cursor Cloud continuity
work.objective: Make DUBSAR Memory usable by Cursor Cloud in this repository without treating advisory routing as authority.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned Cursor Cloud environment resolves the in-repository runtime.
Session open loads resume, route, and pending list without writing memory.
A pending candidate is recorded only with an explicit lot-contract authorization.

work_body: This Work records the Cursor Cloud continuity pilot for the public dubsar-memory repository. It does not claim that the integration is validated, mergeable, or ready to copy into another repository.

checkpoint.summary: Canonical project memory exists for the Cursor Cloud continuity pilot.
limitations: No other repository has received this pilot.
No pending candidate has been promoted into canonical checkpoints.

resulting_state.summary: Canonical memory is ready for the Cursor Cloud session bridges.
